newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Chiquita taps Bank of Boston for $125 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Chiquita taps Bank of Boston for $125 mln loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, November 20 (LPC) - Bank of Boston Corp will launch on Thursday syndication of a $125 million bank loan backing Chiquita Brands International, market sources said.

Pricing on the revolving loan starts at 200 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) for drawn amounts, with a 50 basis point annual fee on undrawn amounts, a banker said. Other information was unavailable.
ING Bank committed $20 million to the co-agent level of the deal, the banker added.
Chiquita will use the credit for general corporate purposes and working capital, bankers said.
